curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the six-point ID and the REAL ID two plus one plus six model, then the vision screening, the basic twenty-fifty standard, the one-eye rule, the tighter CDL standard, CDL self-certification and reporting health problems.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards that keep basic and CDL vision apart and tie the one-eye rule to the basic standard.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the basic and CDL vision standards and the ID models.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Describe what the knowledge test contains and how passing is measured, the offered languages including American Sign Language, the oral option, and the interpreter rules for unlisted languages and for Deaf or Hard of Hearing applicants.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for offered languages versus an interpreter and for foreign-language versus Deaf or Hard of Hearing interpreters.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on test languages, the oral option and interpreter steps.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Compare the adult out-of-state transfer with tests waived, what a transfer applicant still submits and receives, the seventeen-to-eighteen probationary path, and the out-of-country applicant who must test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for adult versus teen transfer and out-of-state versus out-of-country.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps transfer ages, license types and testing rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain Nikhil's Law and the Safety Pledge, then voter registration at the MVC, the Division of Elections route, online address changes and the duty to keep your home address current.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for registering through the MVC versus through the Division of Elections.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the Safety Pledge, voter registration and address changes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show when the permit is validated for practice, the supervised practice minimums for under twenty-one and twenty-one or older, the BA-CSD form and where practice is not allowed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the under twenty-one and adult practice minimums.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps practice months, hours and the BA-CSD form.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: List the original documents for the road test, the red GDL decals, insurance identification for an out-of-state vehicle, rental cars, the accompanying licensed driver and who may be in the car during the test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the accompanying driver versus examiners only during the test.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on road test documents, decals and the accompanying driver.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Correct the belief that only driving is graded, then cover examiner brake access, vehicles that cannot be used, and the common rejection reasons for inspection, brakes, belts, glass, mirrors and the motorcycle-only list.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rejection rule; contrast cards for the inspection sticker versus a failed inspection report.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on vehicle rejection reasons and brake access.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through where the road test happens, gear shifting in a standard transmission, the skills the basic road test covers, the authorization for licensing and the first-license monitoring year.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the basic skills list versus the gear-shifting check.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on road test skills and the steps after passing.
